title: prunella vulgaris subsp. asiatica
intro: Prunella vulgaris subsp. asiatica, commonly known as Asian Selfheal, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae, native to Asia and parts of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various ailments such as fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Asian Selfheal include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
